newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch insurers mull pollution risk policies.
newsitem.headline: Dutch insurers mull pollution risk policies.

text.p: The Dutch Association of Insurers on Wednesday presented a draft proposal for an insurance policy which would cover future claims for damages caused to the environment.
The insurance body said it would be the first environmental risk coverage of its kind available. The policy would cover soil and water pollution, but exclude air pollution.
The new policy, which could also apply to individuals, would carry widely varying premiums, depending on the weight of risk.
Dutch insurers were not yet available to comment on the new policy.
